body:
Alex R: INCIDENT — eu-west POP (ams01) showing high packet loss to edge clients, multiple customers reporting 5xx and timeouts. Notified by error-rate alert and customer pings.
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: New incident created: INC-2026-ams-pop-edge-connectivity. Severity: P1. Paging oncall-network.
OpsBot: Incident channel created. Links: https://ops.redwood/INC-2026-ams-pop-edge-connectivity | Runbook: /runbooks/edge-pop-degraded.md
Maria G: seeing spikes in packet loss starting ~22:08 UTC across 2 upstream peers. Cloud provider console shows increased interface errors on our peering.
Tim H: confirmed. aggregate egress packet loss ~18% for last 5m from our edge metrics. RTT also increased ~200ms.
Lucy S: running quick traceroutes from two vantage points. paste: ```
traceroute to 34.89.12.5 (34.89.12.5), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms 0.3 ms 0.3 ms
 2  100.64.0.1  1.2 ms 1.1 ms 1.1 ms
 3  * * *  (packet loss beyond hop 2)
```
Lucy S: from another location: ```
traceroute to 34.89.12.5
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms
 2  203.0.113.45  45.2 ms 46.1 ms 45.9 ms
 3  * * *
```
Alex R: symptoms align with last-mile/POP egress path dropping; provider peering flaps plausible. Opening ticket with provider now. @oncall-network please assume incident.
oncall-network: Taking incident. I've pulled BGP exports; one of the provider peers is flapping. I'm going to temporarily prep traffic steering to eu-central.
Paul C: Notifying affected customers: listed 4 high-traffic accounts showing increased 5xx and slow responses. Draft customer msg: "We're investigating degraded connectivity affecting EU users; routing mitigations in progress; will update shortly." Thoughts?
Maria G: good. include recommended workaround: switch to eu-central endpoint (eu-central-redirect.redwood) for lowest impact.
Tim H: running a controlled BGP session reset on peer-2 to force re-establish: `ssh bgp-router01` then `clear bgp session peer 203.0.113.14` — doing now.
Lucy S: also purging edge cache for top 50 keys in ams01 to avoid stale retries causing cascades: `edgectl purge --pop ams01 --pattern "top-*"`
oncall-network: Provider responded: "we're seeing packet drops on advertised path, working on infra at their side." They propose moving our peering to alternative fabric within region. Asking for traffic cutover window.
Alex R: initiate immediate partial reroute (80% to eu-central, 20% remain via ams01) and monitor. We want to avoid full flash cut.
Tim H: applied weight changes in our edge LB: `set weight ams01=20 eu-central=80` — pushing now.
Maria G: metrics update: packet loss seen by ams01 internal telemetry dropped from 18% -> 4% after partial shift. RTT still elevated for residual traffic.
Paul C: sent customer notice with mitigation steps and ETA 30m for larger cutover if needed. Included apologies and contact for account teams.
Lucy S: running active probes to measuring path stability — `mtr` output looks like intermittent loss at hop 3. Past 10m average loss now 2-3%.
oncall-network: Provider indicates they've completed fabric change and validated their internal checks. Recommend slowly ramp traffic back once stable for 10m.
Tim H: starting slow ramp: ams01 -> 40%, eu-central -> 60%. Monitoring 1m windows.
Maria G: dashboards show error-rate in affected customer routes dropping: 5xx count down 72% in last 15m.
IncidentBot: Update recorded: mitigation=traffic-steer, status=mitigating, started_by=oncall-network, time=1760501370
Alex R: good. keep watch. please capture exact timestamps and commands for postmortem.
oncall-network: Will handoff to next oncall in 20m. tagging @Tom (next rotation) in the follow-up.
Paul C: customers ACKed and some reported partial recovery. One enterprise customer still seeing packet loss — raised priority with provider for per-flow check.
Tim H: provider ran per-flow checks; they found a misprogrammed route on their transit switch affecting certain prefixes. They fixed it ~22:32 UTC.
Lucy S: post-fix probes show packet loss at <0.5% and latency back to baseline. Edge LB health all green.
Maria G: closing the incident to monitoring. will collect logs and start postmortem draft.
Alex R: Great job coordinating. Postmortem action items: (1) add automated traffic-steer playbook to runbook, (2) improve per-peer health detection thresholds, (3) update customer notification templates.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-ams-pop-edge-connectivity moved to status: resolved. Duration: 10m.
Paul C: drafting customer closure note and sharing timeline.
oncall-network: Handoff complete to next oncall. Leaving notes in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
Alex R: Closing thread. Will link postmortem when ready. Thanks everyone. :team-heart:
